classification.difficultyReason: Select the right triangle within a quadrilateral, find its missing side and combine all four sides as like surds.

content.prompt: A quadrilateral $ABCD$ has side lengths $AB=9\sqrt3$, $BC=6\sqrt3$ and $AD=8\sqrt3$. $\angle ADC=90^\circ$ and the diagonal $AC=\sqrt{267}$. Find the perimeter of the quadrilateral.

spec.description: Source schematic quadrilateral ABCD with diagonal AC and a right-angle mark at D; no parallel markings are added.
spec.mathematics: AB=9sqrt(3), BC=6sqrt(3), AD=8sqrt(3), AC=sqrt(267), angle ADC=90 degrees.
